_cms: CMS module: Website → Stories. These are aspirational journey archetypes describing the paths the movement is built to create — not testimonials from real participants. When real participant stories are approved, replace these and update the section caption in the component.

items.persona: The student in a tier-2 city

stages.text: A real problem, noticed every day — and no idea who to even ask about it.
A campus roadshow, a mentor who asked hard questions, a bootcamp that turned a notion into a plan.
A validated idea, a team, and a pathway that didn't exist before.

items.persona: The engineering team with a prototype

stages.text: A working prototype and no map from the lab bench to the market.
Founders and industry mentors who had shipped before showed where the road actually goes.
From demo to deployment — with an incubator pathway waiting.
Talent everywhere; access nowhere near it.
The movement reached the campus instead of waiting for the campus to reach a metro.
A national stage that judges the idea, not the pincode.
